newsitem.title: USA: Allied Capital cos say to consolidate.
newsitem.headline: Allied Capital cos say to consolidate.

text.p: The five public Allied Capital companies said Thursday that they signed a merger agreement to consolidate into a single, internally managed investment company.

The boards of Allied Capital Corp, Allied Capital Corp II, Allied Capital Commercial Corp, Allied Capital Lending Corp and Allied Capital Advisers Inc has determined that the merger of the companies should have significant benefits for their shareholders, according to a news release issued by Allied Capital.
The merger is to be accomplished through an exchange of shares of the merging companies, the news release said.

Shareholders of Allied Capital Corp, Allied Capital Corp II, Allied Capital Commercial Corp and Allied Capital Advisers would each exchange their shares in the respective companies for shares of Allied Capital Lending Corp, the news release said.
Each board has approved the following exchange ratios that are based upon the market prices of the companies for the 30-day period ended July 15.

Upon the merger effective date, shareholders of Allied Capital Corp would receive 1.07 shares of Allied Capital Lending Corp; shareholders of Allied Capital Corp II would receive 1.4 shares of Allied Capital Lending Corp; shareholders of Allied Capital Commercial Corp would receive 1.6 shares of Allied Capital Lending Corp; and shareholders of Allied Capital Advisers Inc would receive 0.31 shares of Allied Capital Lending Corp.
The new merged company will be named Allied Capital Corp.
The merger will require a two-thirds majority vote of each of the companies' shareholders, and certain regulatory approvals, to become effective.

The news release said the companies are in the process of preparing a joint proxy statement/prospectus to solicit votes from respective shareholders, and the companies expect the solicitation to begin in October, with special meetings of the shareholder groups to be held in early December, the news release said.
The merger is expected to be effective December 31.
